system.name: HNLPU
system.one_liner: a Hardwired-Neuron Language Processing Unit that physically hardwires LLM weights into the chip fabric for extreme inference efficiency

components.name: chip (r,c)
components.role: one of 16 compute modules arranged in a 4x4 logical row-column fully-connected fabric

components.name: Control Unit
components.role: manages on-chip scheduling and inter-layer pipelining for multi-batch scenarios

components.name: HN Array
components.role: dedicated unit performing computation on fixed, pre-trained hardwired weights

components.name: VEX
components.role: Vector Execution Unit computing attention scores, nonlinear activations, residual additions and output sampling

components.name: Inter. Engine
components.role: Interconnect Engine facilitating inter-chip communication and collective operations (broadcast, reduce, scatter, gather)

components.name: Buffer
components.role: on-chip Attention Buffer serving as the KV Cache

components.name: HBM
components.role: off-chip high-bandwidth memory storing KV cache and embedding tables

flows.what: partial sums for aggregation across chips

content.key_idea: HNLPU is built from 16 identical compute modules connected by a router-less, fully-connected row-column fabric, and each module packages an HN Array, VEX, on-chip buffer, control unit and interconnect engine around a shared HBM.
content.reading_order: Left panel (a) first: 4x4 grid of interconnected chips forming the system topology; then right panel (b): zoomed single-chip block diagram showing Control Unit, HN Array, VEX, Buffer and Interconnect Engine stacked over HBM.

summary: This figure presents the overall architecture of the HNLPU system in two panels. Panel (a) shows the system-level topology: 16 compute modules (chip (0,0) through chip (3,3)) arranged in a 4x4 grid, each directly linked to every other module in its row and column via a router-less, fully-connected mesh that supports collective operations like AllReduce. Panel (b) zooms into a single compute module's chip architecture, showing five primary blocks: a Control Unit managing scheduling and pipelining, an HN Array performing hardwired-weight computation, a VEX unit handling attention and nonlinear operations, an on-chip Attention Buffer acting as KV cache, and an Interconnect Engine for inter-chip communication, all sitting above a shared HBM for KV cache and embedding storage. The figure conveys a top-down view from system interconnect down to single-chip microarchitecture.
summary_zh: 该图展示HNLPU系统的整体架构：(a)16个计算模块以4x4行列全连接拓扑互联，支持AllReduce等集合通信；(b)放大展示单个计算模块内部结构，包含控制单元、HN阵列（硬连线权重计算）、VEX向量执行单元、片上注意力缓存和互联引擎，底部共享HBM存储KV缓存与嵌入表。
